newsitem.title: CANADA: Cricket-Rain washes out Sunday decider in Toronto.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Rain washes out Sunday decider in Toronto.

text.p: Heavy rain forced officials to postpone Sunday's series-deciding fifth cricket match between Pakistan and India at the Toronto Cricket, Skating and Curling Club.
Pakistan levelled the Sahara Cup series at 2-2 with a 97 run win over India on Saturday.
Pakistan compiled 258-8 off their maximum of 50 overs while India replied with 161 all out off 39.2 overs.
A capacity crowd at the small ground and an international television audience of tens of millions had been expected to watch Sunday's decider but relentless rain made play impossible.
Organisers said the fifth match would be played on Monday, weather permitting.
